description: Decodes packed five-bit tokens from a stack buffer with the same dispatch as its sibling routines, but without the setup calls.

name: call_get_preferences_library

name: claim_free_record_slot
description: Scans a table of 24-byte records for one whose flag byte at offset sixteen is clear. If none is free it returns zero; otherwise it passes the two arguments and the free slot to a subroutine and returns its result.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:002A
name: dispatch_unless_table_end
description: Returns zero when a frame word equals the fixed end-of-table address. Otherwise it passes three frame arguments to a subroutine and returns its result.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:003C
name: forward_three_frame_arguments
description: Passes three values from the frame to one subroutine routine and returns nothing.

name: open_file_with_mode_string
description: Parses a file mode string whose letters select read, write or append, with optional update and binary flags. It opens the file through a subroutine, seeks to the end for append, and fills in a file record, returning null if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0096
name: open_file_by_mode_letter
description: Reads the mode letter at a stored string position, opens the file with flags chosen by that letter, and fills a file record. It returns the record, or null when the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:00F8
name: open_file_for_append_record
description: Opens a file using the caller's flags with one extra fixed flag, seeks to its end, and fills in a file record with the mode byte. It returns the record, or null if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:012A
name: seek_end_and_fill_record
description: Seeks to the end of an already-open file, sets the mode byte, and fills in a file record. It returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:014C
name: fill_record_flag_checked_mode_two
description: Sets the mode value to two and fills in a file record, with one field chosen by a flag test made through a subroutine. It returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0156
name: open_file_read_or_update
description: Opens a file with a flag derived from a stored byte, records a mode value, and fills in a file record. It returns the record, or null if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0160
name: open_file_record_mode_one
description: Opens a file with the given arguments, records a mode value of one or 128 depending on a stored flag, and fills in a file record. It returns null if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0184
name: fill_record_with_read_mode
description: Sets a mode value of one or 128 depending on a stored flag, then fills in a file record. It returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:0192
name: fill_record_mode_one
description: Sets the mode value to one and fills in a file record. It returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:019A
name: create_file_for_writing
description: Opens a file for writing with a flag chosen from a stored byte and creation settings, then records the mode and fills in a file record. It returns null if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01A4
name: create_file_with_write_flags
description: Opens a file with fixed create and write flags, records a mode of two or 128 depending on a stored flag, and fills in a file record. It returns null if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01DC
name: fill_record_with_write_mode
description: Sets a mode value of two or 128 depending on a stored flag, then fills in a file record. It returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01EA
name: fill_record_with_mode_two
description: Sets the mode value to two and fills in a file record. It returns the record.

name: return_zero_status
description: Returns zero with no other effect, reporting no file record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:01F8
name: fill_record_after_status_check
description: Calls a subroutine and sets a record field depending on the flag it returns, then fills in the file record and returns it.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:022A
name: fill_record_without_flag_check
description: Clears a field in a file record, then stores the mode value and pointers into it and returns the record.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:23:025A
name: clear_object_links
description: Calls one subroutine with the record's link fields when its flag bits allow it. It then clears the two link fields and the flag byte, and passes a byte from the record to another subroutine.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0000
name: lookup_open_table_entry
description: Checks that an index lies within the table bounds and that the top bit of the entry's flag byte is set. It returns the entry's address, or null after setting an error code of nine.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:005C
name: allocate_and_open_file_slot
description: Finds a free entry in the file table, sets its access flags from the open mode bits, deletes the file first when requested, and opens it. It returns the entry index, or minus one with an error code if no slot is free, the mode is invalid, or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:008C
name: open_into_given_file_slot
description: Uses an entry already chosen by the caller, sets its access flags from the mode bits, optionally deletes the file, and opens it. It returns the entry index, or minus one with an error code when the mode is invalid or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:00A6
name: open_file_entry_from_frame
description: Sets access flags for a file entry chosen from the frame, optionally deletes the file, and opens it. It returns the frame's index value, or minus one when the mode is invalid or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:00DE
name: open_file_entry_marking_used
description: Marks a file entry as in use, sets its access flags from the mode bits, optionally deletes the file, and opens it. It returns the frame's index value, or minus one when the mode is invalid or the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0118
name: open_file_entry_append_mode
description: Sets the write-access flag bit on a file entry, optionally deletes the file first, and opens it. It returns the frame's index value, or minus one when the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0124
name: open_file_entry_write_flag
description: Sets a write flag bit on a file entry, optionally deletes the file, and opens it for the caller. It returns the frame's index value, or minus one when the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:013A
name: open_file_entry_append_access
description: Sets the append access bits on a file entry, optionally deletes the file, and opens it. It returns the frame's index value, or minus one when the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0146
name: open_file_entry_combined_access
description: Sets combined access bits on a file entry, optionally deletes the file, and opens it. It returns the frame's index value, or minus one when the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:015C
name: reject_invalid_open_mode
description: Clears the entry's flag byte, sets the invalid-argument error code, and returns minus one.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0170
name: delete_and_open_file_entry
description: Optionally deletes the file, then opens it using the flags held in the frame. It records an I/O error and returns minus one if the open fails, otherwise the frame index.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:019C
name: open_file_entry_fixed_mode
description: Opens a file using a fixed mode value without deleting it first, recording an I/O error and returning minus one if the open fails.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:01E0
name: return_file_entry_index
description: Returns the index stored four bytes below the frame pointer without other work.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:01E8
name: open_with_fixed_access_flags
description: Calls another routine with a fixed access value of 769 combined with the high bit of its flag argument, and passes the remaining bits as a third argument.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:021A
name: read_bytes_from_file_entry
description: Reads a given number of bytes from a file entry's handle into a buffer through the system read call. It records an I/O error on failure, and returns minus one with an invalid-argument code when the count is negative or the entry is missing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0244
name: read_file_into_frame_buffer
description: Reads bytes from the file handle held in the frame into a buffer and stores the byte count it returns in the frame. It records an I/O error if the read fails and returns the stored count.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0282
name: write_bytes_to_file_entry
description: Writes a buffer to a file entry's handle through the system write call, first seeking to the end when the entry's append bit is set. It records an I/O error if the write fails, and returns minus one with an invalid-argument code when the entry is missing or the count is negative.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0306
name: seek_file_to_table_offset
description: Seeks a file entry's handle to a position chosen from a global three-entry offset table, recording an I/O error if that seek fails, then seeks back to the start and returns the result. It returns an error when the entry is missing or the index is out of range.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:038E
name: close_file_entry
description: Closes a file entry's handle unless a flag bit says not to, records an I/O error and minus one if the close fails, and clears the entry's flag byte. It returns minus one when the entry is missing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:03FC
name: delete_named_file
description: Deletes a file through the system delete call, recording an I/O error and returning minus one if the delete fails, otherwise zero.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:042A
name: return_success_status
description: Returns zero with no other effect, reporting success.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0478
name: open_default_file_handle
description: Opens the file named by a global string in a fixed mode and stores the returned handle in a global variable. It returns nothing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:0494
name: read_one_byte_with_pushback
description: Returns a previously stored byte from a one-byte buffer when one is pending, clearing the buffer. Otherwise it reads one byte from the open file handle, opening the default file first if the handle is unset.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:04CC
name: read_byte_from_file
description: Reads one byte from the file handle into a frame slot and returns that byte.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:29:051C
name: write_byte_to_default_file
description: Writes its byte argument to the file handle, opening the default file first if the handle is unset, and returns the byte.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:62:0000
name: forward_two_args_call
description: Forwards its two arguments to one subroutine routine and returns nothing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0000
name: read_buffered_byte_from_stream
description: Returns the next byte from a buffered stream structure, refilling its buffer through a subroutine when it runs out. It returns minus one when the stream is in an error or end state.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:001A
name: read_buffered_byte_from_frame_stream
description: Reads the next byte from the stream whose pointer is held in the frame, refilling its buffer through a subroutine when empty. It returns minus one when the stream reports an error or end state.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0040
name: read_next_buffered_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a buffered stream held in the frame, refilling it through a subroutine when empty. It returns minus one when the stream is in an error or end state.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0056
name: fill_buffer_and_read_byte
description: Marks a buffered stream as read-active, refills its buffer through a subroutine and then returns the next byte. It returns minus one when the stream is already flagged as errored.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:006A
name: refill_and_read_stream_byte
description: Marks a buffered stream as read-active, refills its buffer through a subroutine, and returns the next byte from it. It returns minus one if the stream reports an error or end state.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:00F6
name: next_buffered_byte_no_refill
description: Returns the next byte from a buffered stream's current position and advances it, calling a subroutine to refill only when its count is exhausted.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0112
name: forward_stream_to_helper
description: Passes a stream structure from the frame to one subroutine routine and returns nothing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0120
name: write_byte_to_buffered_stream
description: Writes one byte into a buffered output stream, passing the data through a subroutine when the buffer count runs out, and sets error flag bits in the stream state when a write fails. It returns the byte written, or minus one when the stream is in an error or closed state.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:32:0382
name: allocate_stream_buffer
description: Allocates a buffer for a stream structure through a subroutine using a global size, storing its pointer and size and clearing the stream's flag bits and counters. On failure it sets an out-of-memory error code of twelve and returns minus one.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0000
name: return_global_value_times_eight
description: Loads a global word, shifts it left by three bits so it is multiplied by eight, and returns the result.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0010
name: forward_value_twice
description: Passes its 32-bit argument to one subroutine routine twice, as both arguments, and returns nothing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0026
name: allocate_block_from_free_list
description: Walks a free list of memory blocks to find one at least the requested size, splitting or unlinking it and updating the free total. When no block fits it requests more memory through a subroutine and retries, returning the block address or null.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:010A
name: forward_pointer_with_repeated_size
description: Passes a pointer argument and a duplicate of the second argument to one subroutine routine, then returns nothing.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:38:0124
name: release_block_to_free_list
description: Returns a block of the given size to a sorted free list, merging it with an adjacent block when they touch or linking it in as a new entry. It returns minus one and leaves the list unchanged when the block would overlap an existing free block.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:77:0000
name: report_break_signal_status
description: Checks signal bits reported by a system call and returns zero when neither of the two signal bits is set. When a global flag is set it prints a caret-style marker and a character chosen by the signal type, then each index up to a global count through a subroutine.

key: hitchhiker's guide to the galaxy, the - release 58 (1984)(infocom)[a][serial 851002][wb]/Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, The - Release 58 (1984)(Infocom)[a][serial 851002][WB].adf:Hitchhiker:75:0000
name: divide_signed_magnitude
description: Divides the first value by the second using a restoring shift-and-subtract loop on magnitudes, then negates the quotient when the operands have opposite signs. It returns zero when either input is zero.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0090
name: configure_interrupts_and_dma
description: Writes the audio control, DMA control, interrupt enable and interrupt request registers, and calls five other routines. The decompiled listing timed out, so nothing more is claimed beyond these register accesses and calls.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:020A
name: write_jump_patches_per_variant
description: Compares a global word against a fixed value and, on a match, writes jump and return instruction patterns to several fixed memory addresses before calling a routine through a base table entry. A second fixed value selects a similar alternate set of writes.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0238
name: wait_then_disable_dma
description: Optionally waits while bit seven of a CIA port register stays set, then writes a value with the top bit clear to the DMA control register, disabling the selected DMA channels. It returns its input unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0268
name: forward_clamped_length_output
description: When its character argument is a line feed it adjusts a stored value, queries a length through a table routine, and clamps it to the smallest unsigned value. It then passes the result through another table routine and calls a subroutine.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0424
name: spin_forever_beam_position
description: Loops forever with no exit, and its listed hardware access is the video beam position register. It does nothing else.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:044C
name: call_helper_preserve_value
description: Calls one subroutine routine and returns the data register value unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0458
name: call_helper_return_register
description: Calls one subroutine routine and returns the data register value, which this routine leaves unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0464
name: request_bounded_block_transfer
description: Calls a table routine with a fixed length of 434, a buffer address and a callback, and when it returns a nonzero count, clamps the count to 434 and passes it to a second table routine. It returns the clamped count together with the complement of the second routine's result.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:04A4
name: start_bounded_block_request
description: Calls one table routine with a fixed length of 434, a buffer and a callback, then returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:04D4
name: store_word_and_forward_count
description: Stores a word argument at a pointer, then queries a length through a table routine, clamps it to the smallest unsigned value, passes it to a second table routine, and calls a subroutine. It returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:052C
name: call_two_helpers_in_sequence
description: Calls two subroutine routines one after another and returns, adding no other work.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0544
name: return_no_op_routine
description: Is an empty routine that returns immediately with no effect.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0578
name: set_second_copper_list_address
description: Calls one routine, then stores a fixed copper list address in two global variables, which serve as the second copper list pointer.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:059A
name: set_copper_list_after_setup
description: Runs several setup routines and then stores a fixed copper list address into two global variables used as the second copper list pointer. It returns the value its first call left.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:06AA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Clears a global word, then the decoded code is bad instruction data that stops decoding, so this is a stub with no usable behaviour.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:06B8
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists solely of a return instruction, performing no data manipulation or hardware access.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:06CA
name: store_word_then_send_length
description: Stores a word through a pointer, reads a length through a table routine, clamps it to the smallest unsigned value, passes it to a second table routine and calls a subroutine. It returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0724
name: set_copper_list_pointer_fixed
description: Stores a fixed address into a global variable that serves as a copper list pointer, and returns its input register unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0742
name: set_copper_pointer_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then stores a different fixed address into a global variable used as a copper list pointer. It returns the call's result.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:075A
name: store_fixed_pointer_after_call
description: Calls one routine, then stores a fixed address into a global variable. It returns the call's result.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0772
name: call_table_slot_passthrough
description: Calls a routine through a fixed slot in a base table and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0786
name: call_routines_unless_zero_marker
description: Checks whether a global longword holds the marker text ZERO and, when it does not, calls two routines. It returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:07B0
name: run_sequenced_setup_calls
description: Calls one routine, then a second routine whose result it keeps, then three more routines in sequence, and returns that second result.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:07E8
name: copy_block_then_store_words
description: Copies 430 bytes from one fixed memory block to another, then writes a global word at two offsets past the last destination position.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0818
name: copy_block_back_and_load_words
description: Copies 430 bytes from one fixed block into another in the reverse direction to its sibling, then loads two global words from positions just past the copied bytes.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0844
name: copy_block_then_write_words
description: Copies 430 bytes from one fixed memory block to another, then writes a global word at two offsets past the last destination position.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0874
name: restore_block_and_load_words
description: Copies 430 bytes from one fixed block into another in the reverse direction to its sibling, then loads two global words from positions just past the copied bytes.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:08A0
name: call_routines_unless_zero_marker_v2
description: Checks whether a global longword equals the marker text ZERO and, when it does not, calls two routines. It returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:08CA
name: run_sequenced_calls_keep_second
description: Calls one routine, then a second routine whose result it keeps, then three more routines in sequence, and returns that second result.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0902
name: move_memory_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of bytes from one address to another, copying backwards when the destination overlaps the end of the source and forwards otherwise, using 16-byte chunks before a byte tail. It returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:095E
name: rotate_byte_compare_flag
description: Computes a bit-rotated copy of its byte argument and compares it with a global byte. When they differ it sets bit six of a flag byte in a fixed memory location and returns the original argument; when they match it returns the rotated value.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0980
name: set_flag_bit_six_return
description: Sets bit six of the same flag byte as its neighbouring routine and returns its stack argument unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/Silkworm.slave:0:0BBC
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: This is bad instruction data rather than meaningful code, and decoding stops immediately, so it is a stub with no usable behaviour.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28488
name: run_state_counter_loop
description: Initialises a block of shared globals, calls about forty routines, then loops over a counter from zero to eleven, calling routines and clearing per-pass values. The colour register COLOR00 is one of the hardware registers it touches.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:2871A
name: call_routine_if_word_set
description: Calls one routine when a stored word is nonzero, and returns otherwise.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28726
name: copy_uppercase_text_or_select_index
description: When an active word is set, it either converts an eight-character string to uppercase with control codes replaced by spaces and copies it into a fixed buffer, or stores a one-based index and resets related words.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28776
name: advance_table_on_value_change
description: When a masked status word changes, it records the new value and advances through a table of values. At a marked end entry it sets flags, decrements a counter and stores 4095 in a global word, which is a colour value. It touches the colour register.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:287CA
name: combine_status_and_run_sequence
description: Combines two status words with a mask and returns early when the result is nonnegative or a flag is set. Otherwise it sets flags and runs a sequence of routines, some of them conditional.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28842
name: reset_slot_state_words
description: Sets one state word to three and clears six other state words in the frame.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28862
name: run_counted_wait_loop
description: Makes six routine calls, then runs a timed loop that counts a word down from 550 and returns zero when it reaches zero.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:288AC
name: poll_flags_until_match
description: Makes five routine calls, then polls three flag bytes until their combined value is negative, or until a counter word reaches 69, which it resets to zero.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:288F2
name: countdown_fifty_passes
description: Makes six routine calls, then calls one routine on each of fifty passes of a countdown loop.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28924
name: countdown_two_hundred_passes
description: Makes seven routine calls, then calls one routine on each of two hundred passes of a countdown loop.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28972
name: set_byte_fields_and_call
description: Makes four routine calls, storing 63 and 3 into two pairs of byte fields between the calls.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:289B6
name: clamp_index_and_timed_wait
description: Clamps a stored index to at most seven. When one flag is clear and another is set, it runs a short timed loop with routine calls and returns zero or minus one; otherwise it sets a flag to four and returns zero.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28A40
name: read_line_into_buffer
description: Reads typed characters through a routine into a text buffer, shifting the buffer on backspace or delete and storing other characters up to a limit. Input ends on carriage return or escape, or when a countdown of about four hundred passes runs out with no key.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28B70
name: scan_string_then_countdown
description: Clears a flag word and scans a global byte string with a routine call per byte, stopping at a terminator or when a counter reaches 69. It then runs a countdown of 250 passes and returns zero on a normal finish, minus one otherwise.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28C10
name: format_template_status_line
description: Only runs when a flag word is zero, copying a 23-character template into a buffer and writing the nibbles of six bytes from a record into it as printable digits. The referenced template is a status line with placeholder fields.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28CCC
name: toggle_global_and_countdown
description: Toggles a global word and runs a timed countdown with routine calls. In one timing mode it resets a field periodically, and it returns zero when the countdown reaches zero.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28D4C
name: countdown_from_500_with_pointer
description: Initialises a counter to 500 and a pointer global, then runs a countdown with routine calls on each pass. It returns zero when the counter reaches zero and minus one otherwise.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28DB4
name: run_main_loop_if_code_in_range
description: When a stored code byte lies in the range from the letter P to the letter Y, it runs a block of routine calls and a counter loop that matches the main state loop. Otherwise it returns at once.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28DCE
name: clear_state_on_marker_69
description: When a stored word equals 69, it clears another word, calls two routines, then clears a further word. Otherwise it returns at once.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28DF2
name: reset_record_fields_if_nonnegative
description: When a signed word at offset 64 in a record is zero or positive, it clears the counter and two fields, sets one field to minus one and sets bit zero of a flag byte.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28E12
name: update_steps_from_letter_key
description: Maps six key letters to small step values, stores them in two words, and sets a timer to 500 when the value matches. Other codes return without change.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28E84
name: copy_two_tables_into_frame
description: Copies two sets of eight longword values from fixed table addresses into frame slots and returns nothing.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28EE2
name: clear_sixteen_frame_words
description: Clears a block of sixteen words in the frame, calling two routines around each clear, then calls two more routines and returns.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28F26
name: wait_for_frame_word_value
description: Calls two routines, then loops until a word in the frame reaches 256 and returns.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28F44
name: call_routine_passthrough_registers
description: Calls one routine and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: Silkworm_v1.2_0388/Silkworm/data/01.slk:0:28F54
name: call_two_routines_then_return
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, adding no other work.
